# Madiha Scrap Trading

> Premier licensed scrap dealer, industrial scrap trader, and commercial clearance specialist based in Saki Naka, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

Madiha Scrap Trading provides professional scrap purchasing, factory dismantling, interior demolition, e-waste recycling, and heavy metal scrap logistics across Mumbai and Maharashtra. We offer digital weighing accuracy, instant cash/bank payments, and full GST billing compliance.

## Key Service Regions in Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR)
- **Central Suburbs**: Saki Naka, Andheri East, Andheri West, Kurla, Powai, Chandivali, Ghatkopar, Vidyavihar, Kanjurmarg, Bhandup, Mulund.
- **Commercial & Business Hubs**: MIDC Industrial Area (Andheri), Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC), Seepz, Lower Parel, Worli.
- **Extended Regions**: Thane, Navi Mumbai, Vashi, Rabale, Taloja, Kalyan, Dombivli, Bhiwandi, Panvel.

## Core Services Offered
1. **Commercial & Industrial Scrap Buying**: Bulk purchasing of Heavy Iron (HMS 1 & 2), Copper, Aluminium, Stainless Steel (304/316/202), Brass, Lead, Zinc, Battery scrap, and Machinery offcuts.
2. **Turnkey Interior Demolition & Fit-out Clearance**: Professional office, shop, bank, restaurant, hotel, and warehouse interior dismantling and asset recovery.
3. **E-Waste & IT Equipment Disposal**: Certified processing of server racks, PCBs, motherboards, computers, telecom gear, and office electronics.
4. **Factory & Plant Liquidation**: Decommissioning of heavy machinery, industrial boilers, generators, electric motors, and steel structures.

## Verification & Key Highlights
- **10+ Years Industry Experience**: Trusted scrap trader across Mumbai.
- **700+ Tons Processed Monthly**: Dedicated logistic fleet, cranes, and trained demolition labor.
- **100% Honest Weight Guarantee**: Digital scale measurement on-site.
- **Instant Payment**: Immediate settlement via NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI or Cash.
- **GST Compliance**: Government-approved GST tax invoices provided for all commercial transactions.
